trigger: Only after G0 passes; no B jobs launched yet

collection.failed_trajectories: Retained; fit valid active steps, no initial-state outcome filtering

pilot.perturbation: Gaussian 2% of per-parameter std with1e-3std floor on actor+encoder
pilot.stop: If fitting fails, inspect alignment/normalization/context before expanding

single_expert.initialization: Own verified expert+same2% perturbation, saved epoch0 and own frozen normalizer
single_expert.optimizer_step: After complete600step batch, hidden state detached only at segment boundaries
single_expert.selection: Development only; G1 sourcewise strict gap<=10pp/body gap<=3pp
single_expert.budget: Confirm actual pilot throughput before locking full epochs; no large training before gate

normalization: One inherited frozen normalizer per candidate; experts each retain their own; no cross-expert latent MSE
unified: ConditionalG1; source-balanced trajectory files and balanced open/close x movement/arrival/holding labels; historical init first
